human_name: Chromosome 15 short-arm rDNA + flanking segmental duplications

CHM13.note: T2T-CHM13 v2.0 chr15 p-arm — 0 to centromere boundary (~17.1 Mb). rDNA array core at 2,506,442-4,707,485 (~2.20 Mb). Coordinates from Nurk 2022, doi:10.1126/science.abj6987.

HPRC_pangenome_v1.1.note: HPRC v1.1 acrocentric pangenome — chr15 PHR total 719 kb (SMALLEST of the five — chr15 is the outlier). Per Guarracino 2023.

copy_count_typical: ~51 rDNA copies on CHM13 hap; no/minimal SST1 array (chr15 outlier)
architecture_note: GRCh38 chr15 p-arm is N-masked. chr15 is the outlier of the five acrocentrics: PHR total only 719 kb (vs 2.8-6.5 Mb for chr13/14/21/22), SST1 array absent or minimal, and linkage-disequilibrium decay rate is NOT elevated in chr15 PHR (Guarracino 2023). This means chr15 participates less in ectopic NAHR with other acrocentrics — rob(13;15), rob(14;15), rob(15;22) are rarer than rob(13;14) and rob(14;21).

sst1_array.note: chr15 lacks the prominent SST1 SD block found on chr13/14/21 (Guarracino 2023)

diagnostic_features.ld_decay_in_phr: NOT elevated (unique chr15 feature) — chr15 PHR has same LD decay rate as the long arm, indicating little inter-acrocentric recombination

primary.note: chr15 is structurally most distinct from chr13/14/21 (smaller PHR, no SST1) → more chr15-specific anchors available. May achieve unique mapping more readily than other acrocentrics.

fallback_chain.name: multi_position
fallback_chain.trigger: default for acrocentric SDs but with reduced K due to chr15 specificity

fallback_chain.name: chr15_specificity_anchor
fallback_chain.rationale: chr15 lacks SST1 — absence-of-SST1 is itself a chr15 anchor

primary_sources.note: Nurk S et al., Science. T2T-CHM13 v2.0. rDNA array chr15 2506442-4707485 (2.20 Mb).
Guarracino A et al., Nature. chr15 PHR = 719 kb (smallest), LD decay not elevated — chr15 is the acrocentric outlier.

supporting_databases: UCSC genomicSuperDups — does not cover chr15 p-arm (N-masked in hg38)
ClinGen Recurrent CNV list — Robertsonian rob(13;15), rob(14;15), rob(15;22)
